crop.notes: Headline 'The Prize Ring. Reported Match Between Allen and Mace.' visible on the page is not in the clipping; body is complete

title.suggested: Editorial on Reported Match Between Tom Allen and Jem Mace

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Evening Dispatch noted a New York report that Tom Allen and Jem Mace had made a match, calling them old men and condemning the English prize ring as brutal.

metadata.notes: Masthead reads 'St. Louis Dispatch, Friday Evening, November 19, 1875'; Post-Dispatch did not exist until 1878

facts.fact: A New York telegram reported that a match had been made and forfeit put up for a fight between Allen and Jem Mace

notes: Mostly an editorial against the prize ring.
